name: Sanguine Scion raises Bloodbolt's critical strike chance (#915)
contract: Sanguine Scion 807292's tooltip is "Increases the critical strike chance of Sanguine Mend and Bloodbolt by $s1%", with $s1 = 10 (BasePoints 9 + DieSides 1). Its single effect is aura 107 with MiscValue 7 (SPELLMOD_CRITICAL_CHANCE) over EffectSpellClassMask (524288, 8192, 0): word 0 bit 19 selects the nine Sanguine Mend records (504079-504086, 802310), which the tooltip names, and word 1 bit 13 selects Bloodmoon Blast, which it does not; Bloodbolt is word 1 bit 17 (131072) and that bit is absent, so the second spell the tooltip names received nothing. The discriminating assertion is the crit modifier on Bloodbolt 578305: 0 on today's tree, 10 with the missing bit added. The Sanguine Mend assertion already passes. Bloodmoon Blast is deliberately left unasserted: removing a bit the record carries is a separate question from adding the one it is missing, and this issue reports only the missing Bloodbolt.

steps.label: Bloodbolt has no crit bonus before the talent
Sanguine Mend has no crit bonus before the talent
Sanguine Scion raises Bloodbolt's crit chance by 10
Sanguine Scion raises Sanguine Mend's crit chance by 10
